#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

echo "Creating release archive..."

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for the release
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# Define the archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

echo "Release archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Archive size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"

# Optional: List the contents of the archive
echo "Archive contents:"
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
echo "..."

echo "Deployment archive ready!"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Validates required environment variables first

set -e  # Exit on any error

echo "Starting deployment process..."

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_environment() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test and validate
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            # Extract key (before = sign)
            key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
            
            # Skip if key is empty
            if [ -n "$key" ]; then
                # Get the value of this environment variable
                value=$(printenv "$key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
                
                # Check if value is empty
                if [ -z "$value" ]; then
                    missing_vars+=("$key")
                    echo "Warning: Environment variable '$key' is not set"
                else
                    echo "✓ $key is set"
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    # If there are missing variables, warn but don't exit (since they might be optional)
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Note: Some environment variables from .env.test are not set in current environment."
        echo "This may be OK if they are optional or will be set at runtime."
        echo "Missing variables: ${missing_vars[*]}"
        echo ""
        read -p "Continue with deployment? (y/N): " -n 1 -r
        echo
        if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
            echo "Deployment cancelled by user."
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "All environment variables from .env.test are properly set."
    fi
    
    echo "Environment validation complete."
    echo ""
}

# Run environment validation
validate_environment

# Create release archive
create_archive() {
    echo "Creating release archive..."
    
    # Get the current directory name
    DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
    
    # Create timestamp for the release
    TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
    
    # Define the archive name
    ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
    
    # Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
    tar --exclude='node_modules' \
        --exclude='.git' \
        --exclude='*.log' \
        --exclude='.DS_Store' \
        --exclude='deploy.sh' \
        -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .
    
    echo "Release archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "Archive size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"
    
    # Optional: List the contents of the archive
    echo "Archive contents:"
    tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
    echo "..."
    
    echo "Deployment archive ready!"
}

# Run archive creation
create_archive

        if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            # Extract key (before = sign)
            key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)

                value=$(printenv "$key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

    echo ""

send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if curl is available
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo "Error: curl is required but not installed."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    json_payload="{"
    first=true
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do

send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found. Cannot send config to orchestrator."
        return 1
    fi

    local json_payload="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments

            continue

        fi

            first=false
        else
            json_payload="$json_payload,"
        fi

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_env_vars() {
    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then

        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1)

        # Check if key exists and has a value
        if [ -z "$key" ]; then

        fi
        
        # Check if value is set (not empty)
        if [ -z "$value" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set in .env.test"

    done < .env.test

# Convert .env.test to JSON format
convert_env_to_json() {
    local env_file="$1"
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
        
        # Add to JSON
        if [ -n "$key" ]; then
            if [ "$first" = true ]; then
                first=false
            else
                json="$json,"
            fi
            # Escape quotes in value
            escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
            json="$json\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json="$json}"
    echo "$json"
}

# Deployment script to create a release archive

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_environment() {
  echo "Validating environment variables..."
  
  # Check if .env.test exists
  if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping validation"
    return 0
  fi
  
  # Read each line in .env.test and validate
  local missing_vars=()
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Extract key and value
    local key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
    local value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2- | xargs)
    
    # Check if key exists but value is empty
    if [[ -n "$key" && -z "$value" ]]; then
      missing_vars+=("$key")
    fi
  done < ".env.test"
  
  # Report results
  if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "✓ All environment variables have values"
  else
    echo "✗ Error: The following environment variables are missing values:"
    for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
      echo "  - $var"
    done
    exit 1
  fi
}

echo "Archive size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables and send config to orchestrator
echo "Validating environment variables..."
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format for orchestrator
    JSON_CONFIG="{"
    FIRST_ENTRY=true
    
    # Read each line in .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$line" && "$line" != \#* ]]; then
            # Extract the key and value

            value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
            
            # Add to JSON (escape quotes in values)
            if [ "$FIRST_ENTRY" = true ]; then
                JSON_CONFIG="$JSON_CONFIG\"$key\":\"$value\""

            else
                JSON_CONFIG="$JSON_CONFIG,\"$key\":\"$value\""
            fi
            
            # Check if the key has a value in the current environment
            if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
                echo "Warning: Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
                # Uncomment the next line if you want to stop deployment when a variable is missing
                # exit 1
            else
                echo "✓ $key is set"
            fi
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    JSON_CONFIG="$JSON_CONFIG}"
    
    # Send config to deployment orchestrator
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$JSON_CONFIG" \
        http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config)
    
    if [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 200 ]; then
        echo "Configuration sent successfully to orchestrator"
    else
        echo "Warning: Failed to send configuration to orchestrator (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
        # Uncomment the next line if you want to stop deployment when orchestrator fails

else
    echo "Note: .env.test file not found, skipping environment validation and orchestrator notification"
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_environment() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read .env.test and check each variable
    local missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        var_name="${line%%=*}"
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✓ All environment variables are properly set"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Missing or empty environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set these environment variables before deployment."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping configuration submission."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    local json_content="{"
    local first=true
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first item
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_content="${json_content},"
        fi
        
        # Split key and value
        key="${line%%=*}"
        value="${line#*=}"
        
        # Add to JSON (escaping quotes)
        json_content="${json_content}\"${key}\":\"${value//\"/\\\"}\""
    done < ".env.test"
    
    json_content="${json_content}}"
    
    # POST to deployment orchestrator
    local response
    response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "${json_content}" \
        "http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config")
    
    # Check response
    if [ "$response" -eq 200 ] || [ "$response" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to deployment orchestrator"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Failed to send configuration to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $response)"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Run pre-deployment validation
if ! validate_environment; then
    echo "Deployment aborted due to failed validation."
    exit 1
fi

# Send config to orchestrator
if ! send_config_to_orchestrator; then
    echo "Deployment aborted due to orchestrator communication failure."
    exit 1
fi

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique release naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define the archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='.env' \
    --warning=no-file-changed \
    -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully!"
    echo "Archive size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
    echo "Archive location: $(pwd)/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to create release archive"
    exit 1
fi

validate_env_vars() {

        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
        return 0

    echo "Checking environment variables from .env.test:"

    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do

        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue

        # Extract variable name (before the = sign)
        var_name="${line%%=*}"
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable has a value in current environment
        if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
            echo "  ❌ $var_name is not set in environment"
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
        else
            echo "  ✅ $var_name is set"
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✅ All environment variables are properly set!"
        return 0
    else

        echo "Please set these variables before deployment."
        return 1

        echo "Error: curl is required but not installed"
        exit 1

    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables

    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping environment variable validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Checking environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    local missing_vars=()
    
    # Read .env.test and check each variable
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        local var_name="${line%%=*}"
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty
        if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
            echo "  ❌ $var_name: not set or empty"
        else
            echo "  ✅ $var_name: set"
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: The following required environment variables are not set:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo "Please set these variables before deployment."
        return 1
    else
        echo "All required environment variables are set!"
        return 0
    fi
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping config upload"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines

            continue

        local var_value="${line#*=}"

            continue

        # Add comma if not first item

        first=false

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables from .env.test
validate_env_vars() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read .env.test and check each variable
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [ -z "$var_name" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✓ All environment variables are properly set."
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Error: The following environment variables are not set or are empty:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set these variables before deployment."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping configuration submission."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    json_content="{"
    first=true
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name and value
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2- | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [ -z "$var_name" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first item
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_content="$json_content,"
        fi
        
        # Add to JSON (escaping quotes)
        var_value_escaped=$(echo "$var_value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        json_content="$json_content\"$var_name\":\"$var_value_escaped\""
    done < ".env.test"
    json_content="$json_content}"
    
    # Send to orchestrator
    echo "Configuration data:"
    echo "$json_content" | jq . 2>/dev/null || echo "$json_content"
    
    # Try to send with curl
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$json_content" \
            http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config)
        
        if [ "$response" -eq 200 ] || [ "$response" -eq 201 ]; then
            echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $response)"
            return 0
        else
            echo "✗ Failed to send configuration to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $response)"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Warning: curl not found. Cannot send configuration to orchestrator."
        return 0
    fi
}

echo "Starting deployment process..."

# Run validation
if ! validate_env_vars; then
    exit 1
fi

# Send configuration to orchestrator
if ! send_config_to_orchestrator; then
    echo "Failed to send configuration to orchestrator. Aborting deployment."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Creating release archive..."

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

# Create timestamp for unique filename
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

# Define archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git

    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='dist' \
    --exclude='.env' \
    -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

echo "File size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

# Optional: Show contents of archive
echo ""
echo "Archive contents:"

echo "..."

echo ""
echo "Deployment archive ready!"
